clubIntro: Register your club's referees or new candidates for courses here. The course fee is invoiced to the club.
onlyOwn: Only courses of my state association
noOffers: There are currently no courses open for registration.
full: fully booked, registration goes on the waiting list
feeOnlyOnLicense: only charged if a license is granted
registered: Registered. A confirmation is sent by e-mail.
waitlisted: The course is full, the registration is on the waiting list.
pendingGuardian: Registered. The parents or guardians receive an e-mail and must consent before the registration is valid.
confirmCancelLate: The cancellation deadline has passed, the course fee remains due. Deregister from „{{course}}“ anyway?
late: after the cancellation deadline, fee due
guardianHint: The person is under 16 on the first course day. The parents or guardians receive an e-mail and must consent before the registration is valid.

consent.title: Consent to course registration
consent.intro: {{name}} has been registered for the referee course „{{course}}“.
consent.text: By clicking you consent, as parent or guardian, to the participation and to the processing of the registration data for running the course and granting the license.
consent.done: Thank you. The registration is now valid, a confirmation is sent by e-mail.
consent.doneWaitlist: Thank you. The course has filled up in the meantime; the registration is on the waiting list and moves up automatically when a seat becomes free.
consent.invalid: This link is invalid or has expired. Please contact the club or the course organisers.

confirmCancelPersonLate: The cancellation deadline has passed: the course fee remains due and is invoiced to the club. Deregister {{name}} from „{{course}}“ anyway?

link.failed: That did not work just now, but the link is still valid. Please try again shortly.
